label: Animated content
desc: A reveal wrapper that slides, scales, rotates and un-blurs its content in when it scrolls into view, with per-child stagger, easing presets and a replay-friendly once/repeat switch.
use: Wrap a section, card group or list to reveal it as the page scrolls (direction, distance, threshold, once, stagger, easing).

label: Fade content
desc: An opacity-first reveal wrapper: fade in once, fade in and out as it enters and leaves, or scrub the opacity with scroll position so content dissolves at the edges of its scroll area.
use: Wrap long lists, gallery cards or article blocks that should dissolve into view or out of it.

label: Gradual blur
desc: A progressive edge blur built from stacked backdrop-filter layers with overlapping masks, on any combination of edges, with strength, depth, curve and tint.
use: Drop inside a position:relative scroll area or panel to soften its top, bottom or side edge.

label: Halftone reveal
desc: A picture shown as a rotated halftone dot screen that a soft circular wipe from the pointer (or the centre on scroll-in) turns into the full-colour image.
use: Feature images, team portraits or cards that reveal on hover, tap or when scrolled into view.

label: Logo loop
desc: A seamless endless row or column of logos with edge fade, pause on hover, focus and button, and a plain scrollable row under reduced motion.
use: A "trusted by" strip under a hero, or a vertical partner list in a sidebar.

label: Orbit images
desc: Pictures travelling around an elliptical orbit with depth scaling and dimming at the back, pausing on hover; Space pauses and arrows step the ring.
use: A hero visual or about-page centrepiece around a badge, logo or headline (fills its parent).

label: Pixel swap
desc: A picture swap done in tiles: each square squashes over to the next picture on its own beat, in random, diagonal, row or ripple order, with controls and optional autoplay.
use: A hero or product image that changes between views, with previous/next controls.

label: Pixel transition
desc: A hover, focus or tap transition that pixelates one picture into chunky blocks in a few stages and resolves it into another.
use: A before/after, day/night or team-photo card that switches pictures on interaction.

label: Scroll expand
desc: A framed picture that grows to full bleed as you scroll while the headline splits apart, then the page content continues below.
use: A story or product opener; works as its own scroll area or with page scroll.

label: Shape blur
desc: A soft shape that chases the pointer on a spring, blurring and stretching with speed, sharpening at rest and drifting on its own when idle.
use: Behind a hero or empty state (fills its parent; layer content on top via children).

label: Star border
desc: A container, button or link whose border is circled by glowing four-point stars with comet tails, speeding up on hover and focus.
use: Highlight a primary call to action or a featured pricing card.

label: Sticker peel
desc: A sticker with a corner that curls with a computed fold line, backing paper and shading: hover near the corner, drag to peel, keyboard arrows to adjust.
use: A playful decorative sticker on a card, device mock-up or hero collage.
